name: QuoteMarquee
job: Compact drop-in slider of customer quote cards gliding endlessly in a row, sitting inside any section, so social proof feels abundant and alive
visitor_action: hover/focus pauses and lifts a card; drag to scrub on touch; pause button for accessibility
owner_settings: Quotes (text, person name, role, photo, star rating)
Number of rows (1 by default, or 2)
motion: continuous seamless glide with soft edge fades and depth/tilt on the focused card (reduced-motion: static scrollable row)
